# Twitch script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

![A Run Python code step in the action editor](../../assets/screens/actions-python-step.png)

## twitch.addBlockedTerm

Adds a word or phrase to your Twitch blocked terms, so messages with it are hidden. Fails when the term is empty. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `term` | `term` | The word or phrase to block, like "buy followers". |

**Gives back:** An object with blockedTermId.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.addBlockedTerm", new { term = "buy followers" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_add_blocked_term(term="buy followers")
    ```

## twitch.addModerator

Makes a viewer a moderator in your Twitch channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user` | `user` | Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.addModerator", new { user = "coolviewer42" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_add_moderator(user="coolviewer42")
    ```

## twitch.addScheduleSegment

Adds a stream to your Twitch schedule. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `start` | `start` | Optional. When it starts, like 2026-12-01 19:00, in this computer's time zone. |
| `duration` | `duration` | Optional. How long it runs, in minutes (30 to 1380). |
| `title` | `title` | Optional. The stream's title, up to 140 characters. |
| `category` | `category` | Optional. A category name or id. Leave empty for none. |
| `recurring` | `recurring` | Optional. Tick to repeat it every week. |

**Gives back:** An object with scheduleSegmentId.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.addScheduleSegment", new { start = "2026-12-01 19:00", duration = "180", title = "Cozy games", recurring = "true" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_add_schedule_segment(start="2026-12-01 19:00", duration="180", title="Cozy games", recurring="true")
    ```

## twitch.addSuspiciousStatus

Marks a viewer as suspicious. "Active Monitoring" flags their messages for your mods; "Restricted" keeps their messages out of chat. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `user` | `user` | Optional. A Twitch login name (a leading @ is fine) or "id:12345". Leave it out for the user who triggered the action. |
| `status` | `status` | Optional. "Active Monitoring" (the default) or "Restricted". |

**Gives back:** An object with suspiciousUser, suspiciousUserName, suspiciousUserId, suspiciousUserType, suspiciousStatusResult, suspiciousStatus (like "RESTRICTED") and suspiciousTypes.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.addSuspiciousStatus", new { user = "coolviewer42", status = "Restricted" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_add_suspicious_status(user="coolviewer42", status="Restricted")
    ```

## twitch.ban

| --- | --- | --- |

## twitch.configureRewards

Turns many channel point rewards on, off, paused or unpaused in one go. Fails when a name matches no reward or group. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enable` | `enable` | Optional. Reward titles, ids or reward group names, one per line or separated by \|. |
| `disable` | `disable` | Optional. Reward titles, ids or reward group names, one per line or separated by \|. |
| `pause` | `pause` | Optional. Reward titles, ids or reward group names, one per line or separated by \|. |
| `unpause` | `unpause` | Optional. Reward titles, ids or reward group names, one per line or separated by \|. |
| `disableNotConfigured` | `disable_not_configured` | Optional. true also turns off every reward that is in no reward group. Leave it out for false. |

**Gives back:** An object with rewardsChanged and rewardsSkipped (rewards Cuebot could not change).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.configureRewards", new { enable = "Hydrate!|Stretch", disable = "Games" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_configure_rewards(enable="Hydrate!|Stretch", disable="Games")
    ```

## twitch.createClip

Makes a clip of your live Twitch stream. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hasDelay` | `has_delay` | Optional. true makes the clip account for your stream delay. Leave it out for false. |
| `title` | `title` | Optional. The clip's title. Leave it out to use your stream title. |
| `duration` | `duration` | Optional. The clip's length in seconds, 5 to 60. Leave it out for Twitch's 30 seconds. |

**Gives back:** An object with clipId, clipEditUrl, clipUrl, createClipSuccess, createClipId, createClipCreatedAt and createClipUrl.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.createClip");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_create_clip()
    ```

## twitch.createClipFromVod

Clips a moment that already happened, from your current or a past broadcast. Use it for "clip the last 2 minutes" style commands. Twitch only allows this when past broadcasts are stored on your channel. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `title` | Optional. The clip's title. Twitch requires one. |
| `secondsAgo` | `seconds_ago` | Optional. When no video id is given: how many seconds ago the clip should end, counted back from now in the current broadcast. 0 ends it now. |
| `duration` | `duration` | Optional. How long the clip is, in seconds, from 5 to 60. |
| `videoId` | `video_id` | Optional. The video to clip. Leave empty for your current (or latest) broadcast. |
| `endOffset` | `end_offset` | Optional. With a video id: where the clip ends, in seconds from the start of the video. |

**Gives back:** An object with clipId, clipUrl, clipEditUrl and clipVideoId.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.createClipFromVod", new { title = "That play", secondsAgo = "60", duration = "30" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_create_clip_from_vod(title="That play", seconds_ago="60", duration="30")
    ```

## twitch.createPoll

Starts a Twitch poll in your chat with 2 to 5 choices. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `title` | The question, like "Which game next?" |
| `choices` | `choices` | The answers as text, one per line or separated by \|, like "Minecraft\|Fortnite\|Tetris". |
| `duration` | `duration` | Optional. How long the poll runs, in seconds (15 to 1800). Leave it out for 60. |
| `pointsPerVote` | `points_per_vote` | Optional. Channel points for each extra vote. Leave it out (or 0) to turn extra votes off. |

**Gives back:** An object with pollId and success (true).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.createPoll", new { title = "Which game next?", choices = "Minecraft|Fortnite|Tetris", duration = 120 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_create_poll(title="Which game next?", choices="Minecraft|Fortnite|Tetris", duration=120)
    ```

## twitch.createPrediction

Starts a Twitch prediction: viewers bet channel points on 2 to 10 outcomes. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `title` | The question, like "Will I beat the boss?" |
| `outcomes` | `outcomes` | The outcomes as text, one per line or separated by \|, like "Yes\|No". |
| `window` | `window` | Optional. How long viewers can bet, in seconds (30 to 1800). Leave it out for 120. |

**Gives back:** An object with predictionId, prediction.Id and success (true).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.createPrediction", new { title = "Will I beat the boss?", outcomes = "Yes|No", window = 60 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_create_prediction(title="Will I beat the boss?", outcomes="Yes|No", window=60)
    ```

## twitch.createReward

Makes a new channel point reward. Cuebot can change it later because it made it. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `title` | The reward name, like "Hydrate!" |
| `cost` | `cost` | Optional. The price in channel points. Leave it out for 100. |
| `prompt` | `prompt` | Optional. The text viewers see under the title. |
| `inputRequired` | `input_required` | Optional. true makes viewers type a message when they redeem. Leave it out for false. |
| `enabled` | `enabled` | Optional. false makes it hidden at first. Leave it out for true. |

**Gives back:** An object with createdRewardId.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.createReward", new { title = "Hydrate!", cost = 500, prompt = "Make me drink some water" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_create_reward(title="Hydrate!", cost=500, prompt="Make me drink some water")
    ```

## twitch.getBroadcaster

Gives you your signed-in Twitch account as Cuebot knows it. Works without asking Twitch.

**Gives back:** An object with userId, userName, connected (true when Twitch is connected) and scopes (the permissions you gave).

| `reward` | `reward` | Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed. |
| `max` | `max` | Optional. The limit, like 1. 0 (the default) removes the limit. |
| `additive` | `additive` | Optional. true adds max to the current limit (a negative number lowers it) instead of replacing it. Leave it out for false. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.setRewardMaxPerUser", new { reward = "Hydrate!", max = 1 });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_set_reward_max_per_user(reward="Hydrate!", max=1)
    ```

## twitch.timeout

## twitch.updateGuestStarSettings

Changes your Twitch Guest Star settings. Anything left at its default stays as it is. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `slotCount` | `slot_count` | Optional. How many guest slots, 1 to 6. Leave it out (or 0) to keep it. |
| `layout` | `layout` | Optional. "TILED_LAYOUT", "SCREENSHARE_LAYOUT", "HORIZONTAL_LAYOUT", "VERTICAL_LAYOUT" or "Keep" (the default). |
| `moderatorSendLive` | `moderator_send_live` | Optional. Whether moderators can send guests live: "On", "Off" or "Keep" (the default). |
| `browserSourceAudio` | `browser_source_audio` | Optional. Whether the browser sources play audio: "On", "Off" or "Keep" (the default). |
| `regenerateBrowserSources` | `regenerate_browser_sources` | Optional. true makes new browser source links; the old ones stop working. Leave it out for false. |

**Gives back:** Nothing.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.updateGuestStarSettings", new { slotCount = 4, layout = "TILED_LAYOUT" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_update_guest_star_settings(slot_count=4, layout="TILED_LAYOUT")
    ```

## twitch.updateGuestStarSlotSettings

Changes audio, video, live state or volume of one Twitch Guest Star slot. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| --- | --- | --- |

## twitch.updateReward

Changes the name, text and price of a channel point reward in one go. Empty values stay as they are. Twitch only lets Cuebot change rewards that Cuebot made. Fails when Twitch is not connected.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `reward` | `reward` | Optional. The reward's title or id, like "Hydrate". Leave it out for the reward that was just redeemed. |
| `title` | `title` | Optional. The new name. Leave it empty to keep it. |
| `prompt` | `prompt` | Optional. The new text. Leave it empty to keep it. |
| `cost` | `cost` | Optional. A number. With "Set" it becomes the new price; with the other operators it changes the current price (never below 1). |
| `operator` | `operator` | Optional. "Set" (the default), "Add", "Subtract", "Multiply" or "Divide". |

**Gives back:** An object with rewardCost (the price now).

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("twitch.updateReward", new Dictionary<string, object?> { ["reward"] = "Hydrate!", ["cost"] = 100, ["operator"] = "Add" });
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.twitch_update_reward(reward="Hydrate!", cost=100, operator="Add")
    ```
